new_ops.reason: Needs Transformer-XL relative-position attention with cached previous-segment memory concatenated to keys/values, per-head relative segment encodings (s_+/s_- with head bias b) added to attention scores, and an arbitrary permutation-derived attention mask; also two-stream (query stream) variant. No IR attention primitive supports relative position/segment score terms, memory, or permutation masks.
new_ops.quote: attention with relative positional encoding and position-wise feed-forward are consecutively employed to update the represetntations

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Two-stream self-attention: a query stream g initialised with a trainable vector w, sharing parameters with the content stream, cannot see its own content; used for prediction during pretraining and dropped at finetuning
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Computationally, the first layer query stream is initialized with a trainable vector, i.e. $g_i^{(0)} = w$, while the content stream is set to the corresponding word embedding, i.e. $h_i^{(0)} = e(x_i)$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Segment recurrence: cached per-layer content representations of the previous segment used as extra keys/values
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Then, based on the permutation $\tilde{\rvz}$, we process the first segment, and then cache the obtained content representations $\tilde{\rvh}^{(m)}$ for each layer $m$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Relative segment encodings added to attention scores
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: When $i$ attends to $j$, the segment encoding $\mathbf{s}_{ij}$ is used to compute an attention weight $a_{ij} = (\mb{q}_i + \mb{b})^\top \mb{s}_{ij}$, where $\mb{q}_i$ is the query vector as in a standard attention operation and $\mb{b}$ is a learnable head-specific bias vector.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Permutation of factorization order via attention masks (positional encodings follow original order)
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: In other words, we keep the original sequence order, use the positional encodings corresponding to the original sequence, and rely on a proper attention mask in Transformers to achieve permutation of the factorization order.
